apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added MangaBaka tracking for servers that support it (@aaronbamblett)
- Let Linux windows shrink to phone size, switching to the phone layout (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Showed the number of extension updates on the **Extensions** tab (@aaronbamblett)
- Gave desktop pages one consistent layout, with a single row top bar and content clear of the scrollbar (@aaronbamblett)
- Gave Linux windows rounded corners and GNOME style window buttons (@aaronbamblett)
- Showed the full sidebar from 1000 pixels wide and gave its toggle a panel icon (@aaronbamblett)
- Made **Manga Grid Size** set the smallest a cover can be, so the grid fits as many columns as the window allows (@aaronbamblett)
- Gave source names their own row on desktop Browse cards and fit the cards to narrow windows (@aaronbamblett)
- Collapsed the Library sort, filter and display buttons into one button in narrow desktop windows (@aaronbamblett)
- Cleaned up onboarding on desktop so the logo shows once and Skip and Next stay in place (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed chapters with a single page never being marked read (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Simple Login** sign-in on the latest Suwayomi server (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed restoring a backup or installing an extension from a file with **Basic Auth** on the latest Suwayomi server (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed reader pages not loading on macOS (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the Mac app signing you out after a denied or missed keychain prompt (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Restore Backup** greying out backup files on Android (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed tracker sign-in in the web app, including when it is hosted under a subpath (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed MyAnimeList, Bangumi and MangaUpdates series landing in the wrong groups with **By track status** (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed long press page actions not opening in paged reading modes, including **Save spread** in double page view (@aaronbamblett)
- Stopped long strip marking the previous chapter read when it loads above the current one (@aaronbamblett)
- Stopped opening a read chapter resetting its saved page (@aaronbamblett)
- Showed a loading indicator on long strip pages and stopped pages jumping while they load (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed double page view jumping back a page when a wide page loads (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed hidden categories missing from the library category filter (@aaronbamblett)
- Stopped mouse drags switching Library categories and tabs on desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Stopped the Updates and History scrollbar jumping while scrolling on desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Stopped desktop toolbars overflowing in narrow windows (@aaronbamblett)
- Hid **Lock to portrait** on devices where it can't work (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Constantin Piber for German, Kisnov for Catalan and Andrei Stepanov for Russian.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)
